scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rebuy/contracts && npm run build --workspace backend-express-ts && npm run build --workspace frontend-next
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @rebuy/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace backend-express-ts && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend-next
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend-express-ts && npm run test --workspace frontend-next
